metadata.explanation: N-Cbz protection of 3-hydroxypyrrolidine with benzyl chloroformate and base. Validated: dataset exact match.
Oxidation of secondary alcohol N-Cbz-3-hydroxypyrrolidine to ketone (e.g., Swern/PCC). Validated: dataset exact match.

Direct Cbz protection of 3-pyrrolidinone, by analogy to the 4-piperidone Cbz-Cl precedent (US05852040). The validator found no dataset support for this exact step, and 3-pyrrolidinone did not come up in the stock lookup.
Strecker reaction of 1-benzyl-4-piperidone with aniline and a cyanide source. The validator found no dataset support. The ketone and aniline were confirmed in stock; the cyanide source (KCN) was not.
Partial hydration of the α-aminonitrile to the primary amide (usually done in conc. H2SO4). This step matches an exact dataset record.

N-benzylation of the secondary piperidine amine with benzyl bromide and base. The validator found no dataset support. Benzyl bromide was confirmed in stock; the NH-piperidine amide was not checked and is left unexpanded.
Make the oxime by condensing the ketone with hydroxylamine. The validator found an exact dataset match for this step.
Reduce the oxime to the primary amine. The validator found an exact dataset match for this step.
Reductive amination of the ketone with benzylamine. The validator found an exact dataset match for this step.
Remove the N-benzyl group by hydrogenolysis. The validator found an exact dataset match for this step.
